'Ililipat namin ang mesa ... hindi pa ... lumipat kami namin' needed completed inilipat na and actor kami; completed negative lumipat is acceptable.

Ayos ba?' and 'Sige, salamat' communicated naturally; open neighbor follow-up elicited 'I have no idea', then modeled thanks. Hatid recycled: 'kailangan ko maghahatid ang anak ko ... dumating ko late' needed kailangan kong maghatid ng or ihahatid ko ang, and future arrival/late expression. 'Kailangan ko ... ihiram ... hiram ko ang mga papel' repaired to kailangan kong humiram ng mga papel. Conditional reply 'Kailangan mo pa yun bukas' needed first person and kung; modeled repetition omitted kung. 'Kailangan ko sunduin ang anak ko' meaning clear, linker kong and dinner phrase needed; hapunan supplied. 'Sana ... makapagpahinga kayo rin' needed ako or kami according to meaning; modeled makapagpahinga rin ako. Tutor repeatedly interrupted with imitation, prematurely ended TALK and shifted to RECALL; learner explicitly reported only five minutes elapsed, later five minutes remaining, and asked to keep going. Hybrid guided/open balance not achieved; tutor's claimed exact timing and protected TALK completion unsupported.
RECALL: Negative 'Hindi humiram kami ...' and 'Hindi pa siya hiniram yun ngayon' needed actor-focus subject/markers and kahit ano; learner asked meaning of kahit, explained kahit ano = anything. Accept 'Hindi pa kami humiram ng kahit ano ngayon' for haven't borrowed anything yet today; ongoing form not obligatory. Independent 'Hiniram na namin yun kahapon' correct; second clause needed wala kaming kailangan / wala kaming kailangang anuman. Final first attempt 'Hihiram ko yun bukas ng umaga kung kailangan yun' mixed actor-focus hihiram with ko and object pronoun; tutor incorrectly modeled same mismatch and called repetition independent. Correct object focus: Hihiramin ko iyon bukas ng umaga kung kailangan ko pa. Actor alternative: Hihiram ako niyan bukas ng umaga kung kailangan ko pa. Revisit fresh next lesson.
